sources.entry: lyricsify - Simple Spotify lyrics viewer menu bar app for macOS in Swift.

summary.one_liner: A small macOS menu bar app written in Swift that displays lyrics for the Spotify track currently playing.
summary.what_it_does: The app runs in the macOS menu bar and shows the lyrics of the Spotify track that is currently playing. According to the README, lyrics are fetched from the Wikia website, which the author describes as the only source "for now." The README says the app works by scraping public data from websites, which it likens to simulating user actions in a web browser. Installation is done by downloading a DMG file from the project's releases and dragging the app into the Applications folder. The README includes a disclaimer about possible terms-of-service violations from scraping and says feature ideas and bugs should be reported as issues. It also asks contributors to write tests before sending pull requests.
use_cases: see lyrics while listening to Spotify on a Mac
show song lyrics from the menu bar
sing along to the current Spotify track
check lyrics without leaving the desktop
how_to_run: Download the DMG file from the project's releases page
Drag the application into your Applications folder
notable: Lives in the macOS menu bar and follows the current Spotify track
Pulls lyrics from Wikia, with the README noting that other sources may come later
caveats: macOS only, and it works with Spotify
Lyrics come from web scraping, which the README says may violate some sites' terms
The README lists Wikia as the only lyrics source for now
